Avoid ASRock AM5 boards, CPU degradation issues still reported
Choose boards with ALC1220 audio codec when possible

>RAM
Crucial RAM & SSD warranty offers refunds only, no replacements
DDR5: 2x16GB or 2x24GB, 6000CL30 (AMD), 6400CL32 (Intel)

>GPU
Buy the best one you're willing to pay for

A Russian Molniya drone guided by an Nvidia Jetson Orin computer chose its own target and killed three people at a petrol station in Zaporizhzhia on 6 July, according to Ukrainian forensic investigators.

Tetiana Bubynets, a 19-year-old accounting student, and two men aged 41 and 48 died. His administration lobbied the U.S. Congress to drop chip export limits that Nvidia opposed. The U.S. Commerce Department, which enforces export controls, routed its investigators' contact with Nvidia through a political appointee after the company's general counsel called him. item.title: [ 30] Republican staffer indicted over false flag anti-Trump attack, paid to have face cut and tied up
item.description:
https://www.nbcnews.com/news/us-news/former-gop-staffer-indicted-fake-anti-trump-attack-allegedly-paid-face-rcna610578

Two New Jersey women were indicted after being accused of falsely reporting that one of them, a former staffer for U.S. Rep. Jeff Van Drew, R-N.J., was the target of a violent political attack in 2025.

On Friday, the U.S. Attorney’s Office for the District of New Jersey announced that Natalie Greene, 27, of Ocean City, was indicted on charges of conspiracy to convey false statements and hoaxes, conveying false statements and hoaxes, and making false statements to federal law enforcement.

She had previously been charged with the same offenses in a federal criminal complaint.

Officials said Anamaria Moe, 25, of Atlantic City, was newly charged in the indictment with conspiracy to convey false statements and hoaxes and conveying false statements and hoaxes.

Moe made her initial appearance in federal court in Camden on Thursday.

On July 23, 2025, prosecutors said Moe called 911 and claimed she and Greene had been attacked by three men while walking on a trail at a nature preserve in Egg Harbor Township, New Jersey.

Officials said Moe told authorities that the men called Greene by name and referenced her employment with a federal official, later identified as Republican Rep. Jeff Van Drew.

When police arrived at the scene, they found Greene on the ground in a wooded area near the trail with her hands and feet bound with black zip ties. Greene’s shirt was pulled over her head and secured with a zip tie, investigators said.

Greene also had several lacerations on her face, neck, upper chest and shoulder, according to officials.

Police said the words “TRUMP WHORE” were written on her stomach, while a message claiming that Van Drew “IS RACIST” was written on her back.

The real 'dirty bomb' attack comes from within by republicans as trump's revenge tour now reaches Iowa

https://www.reuters.com/legal/government/iowa-detonation-lead-will-proceed-under-emergency-powers-army-says-bypassing-2026-11-22/

NEW YORK, Nov 22 (Reuters) - The US Army will detonate 68 barrels of toxic lead azide in Iowa by Tuesday under emergency legal powers that allow it to bypass a court order blocking the controversial plan, the Trump administration told a court this weekend.

The US Court of Appeals for the 8th Circuit temporarily halted the detonation by freezing the Army’s environmental permit on Thursday after environmental groups sued to halt the operation. The government said in Saturday night's filing that the Army plans to move forward without a permit by invoking an emergency munitions and explosives exception to federal environmental protection laws.

“The Army must perform a controlled detonation to protect the public from the more significant threat from an uncontrolled explosion, and the Army intends to act by November 24, 2026,” the Justice Department said in a court filing late on Saturday.

Federal officials say the detonation must go forward within the next several days because a drop in temperature could destabilize the material and cause an uncontrolled explosion.

The Army previously postponed plans to detonate the degraded lead azide, an explosive used in military munitions, after public outcry by residents and farmers near Middletown, Iowa.

The Army did not immediately respond to an inquiry on Sunday about the precise timing of the detonation.

The Iowa Environmental Council and the Sierra Club's Iowa chapter filed the lawsuit.

item.title: [ 88] Mamdani Was Arrested Twice by Elite NYPD Unit He's Disbanding
item.description:
https://nypost.com/2026/11/20/us-news/mayor-mamdani-was-arrested-at-least-twice-by-elite-nypd-unit-hes-controversially-disbanding/

Mayor Zohran Mamdani was at least twice zip-tied and arrested by the elite NYPD tactical unit he is disbanding, old photos show.

Hizzoner announced Monday that the NYPD’s Strategic Response Group (SRG) will be folded into an existing counterterrorism command and will no longer respond to protests, sparking widespread outrage and urgent warnings from rank-and-file officers.

But Mamdani did not mention his personal brushes with the unit, with footage showing him being hauled away by SRG officers at least twice years before he landed in Gracie Mansion, Crain’s New York Business first reported.

In June 2024, ABC7 filmed Mamdani — then a New York state assemblymember who would just months later announce his run for mayor — with his hands zip-tied behind his back as he was escorted away from a protest outside of Hunter College in Manhattan.

The future mayor, who had not yet announced he was running for the city’s top office, had joined protesters rallying against the Rent Guidelines Board’s vote on increases for rent-stabilized apartments.

The cop escorting Mamdani had the SRG insignia on his shoulder and the words “NYPD Strategic Response Group” on his back, as did other officers around him, the video shows.

Years earlier, in August 2021, then-Assemblyman Mamdani posted a video on his personal X account showing himself in a mask again being zip-tied and taken away by an SRG officer during a protest in Downtown Brooklyn.

Mamdani and other demonstrators were demanding an extension of the state’s eviction moratorium. He said he and fellow Assemblymember Marcela Mitaynes were among those taken into custody.

“I was among 17 who were arrested during our protest,” Mamdani posted. “We’re out now & we’ll keep fighting for these tenant protections to be passed.”

item.title: [173] /out/ings with a Pipe Autumn Edition
item.description:
Last thread >>2868475

This is a thread for enjoying a pipe while doing outdoor activities. If you ask why this belongs on /out/, you've never spent
an evening by the campfire with a pipe silently enjoying the nature around you, and you're missing out.

>how to get started
Purchase a corn cob pipe (or a cheap briar pipe) and a pouch of Half and Half or Captain Black tobacco from a smoke shop
or online. You will need a lighter or match, and something to tamp it with--a large nail works well if you don't have a pipe tool.
Fill the pipe with tobacco, pack it down halfway, top it off, pack it down to 3/4, top it off again, pack gently and enjoy. Smoke
slower than you think you need to, the tobacco tastes best when it is burning cool. Tamp and re-light as needed. If you still
have trouble, try different methods on YouTube until you find one that works for you.
>smoking a pipe will give you cancer
Originally the Surgeon General found that pipe and cigar smokers, following a careful study of the statistics (at a time when
